note: Public roofs from Czech public tenders (E-ZAK portals): the tender's project documentation and its bill of quantities (soupis prací / výkaz výměr), or totals printed on the roof plan itself. The files are public and can be downloaded again from `source`; they are not stored here. Bills are written by an estimator and can be gross (see each `note`), so a difference is a reason to check the bill's formula as much as the build.

jobs.note: Gable roof 59.38 m between two 0.78 m gable walls, 12.85 m wide, 48° with a 42° sprocket at the eave (section: covering 7.255 m at 48° + 2.13 m at 42° per side). The bill's 60.94 x 10.63 x 2 counts the length over the gable walls and adds the 2.01 m sprocket to the full 8.62 m rafter although they overlap by 1.46 m, so it is about 14 % over the drawn covering (1112.8 m² built).

jobs.note: Hipped villa roof with six wings, all ridges at one height (+12.716 in every elevation), so the narrower wings are steeper. No pitch is written; section A-A gives 39° but cuts at a wing junction. One pitch of 39° everywhere: 435.2 m², ridge 23.5, hips 86.5, valleys 50.0. Wings as parts with level ridges and the main wing at 34° (ridge 3.8 m above the eave line) match the printed totals: about 461 m², ridge 32.2, hips 72.6, valleys 49.1. Open: which height the eave line is at (the cornice is +7.750, the eaves are flared).

offers.covering: clay interlocking tiles, bill of quantities and the summary report

jobs.note: U-shaped hipped roof: two heads at 34° and 33°, two wings and a south block at 28°, all eaves at +16.782. The bill's eave (263.62) is exactly the perimeter of the roof edge drawn on the plan, and its ridge (94.8) plus hip (118.18) and valley figures are within about 1 % of the roof the plan describes, but its area (2322.32, the summary report's 'plocha střechy 2 322 m2') is about 9 % more than the planes of these pitches cover (about 2134 m²); no figure on the sheets explains it, so the area is information only.
